summary: Phase 3 (shipment + 2-way match) and Phase 4 (internal GRN approval with best-effort SAP GR posting) tested end-to-end: 24 new pytest API tests (all pass) + full browser flows for the vendor dashboard (login -> Ship dialog -> 6-char code -> shipments table) and the internal GRN Approval page (case-insensitive lookup, approve with SAP-pending banner+toast, reject with reason, pending-row click, unknown-code error). Phase 1/2 regression suite re-run: 25/25 pass after updating 2 stale assertions that contradicted intentional behaviour changes. No functional defects found; only minor/cosmetic and hardening observations.

minor.issue: Aggregation matches on po_number only (no vendor_code filter), so if two vendors ever have the same PO number cached, one vendor's shipments would consume the other's remaining open qty in the 2-way match.
Remaining-qty check and insert are not atomic - two concurrent submissions on the same PO item can both pass validation and over-ship (no unique/conditional write guard).

Only SAPGSAWriteError is caught; any other unexpected exception from the SAP client path (non-requests error) would surface as HTTP 500 and block the internal approval, contradicting the 'approval never blocked' requirement. Suggest catching Exception for the posting attempt only.

No retry/backfill path for shipments left at sap_sync_status='pending'. Once SAP_SOAP_GSA_WRITE_ENDPOINT is configured, already-approved shipments will stay 'pending' forever - a re-post endpoint or background retry job is needed.

issues: Status badge renders the raw enum ('in_transit', 'approved', 'rejected') whereas the vendor dashboard shows friendly labels ('In Transit', 'Received', 'Rejected') - inconsistent wording for the same data.

Doc code alphabet includes visually ambiguous characters (0/O, 1/I) - observed codes YXW0D3 and 3XI023. Since the code is hand-transcribed onto physical paperwork and typed at the dock, excluding O/0/I/1 would cut transcription errors.

For a user with only supplier_portal_admin the single top-nav group is labelled 'Master Data' but contains 'Supplier Portal Approvals' + 'GRN Approval' - misleading group label (pre-existing NavTabs grouping, not new this session).

action_items: Add vendor_code to the _shipped_qty_so_far $match so 2-way match is scoped per vendor.
Broaden the exception guard around gsa_write_client.post_goods_receipt() to Exception so no SAP-side surprise can 500 the internal approval.
Plan a retry/re-post path for shipments stuck at sap_sync_status='pending' once the real GSA write endpoint lands.
Optional: humanise the status badge text on the GRN page and drop ambiguous 0/O/1/I from the doc-code alphabet.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~5589 lines - well past the 700-line guideline; the supplier-portal/GRN route block is a good candidate to move into its own router module.
create_shipment() validates remaining qty then inserts without any atomic guard - concurrent vendor submissions can breach the PO open quantity.
_shipped_qty_so_far() is not vendor-scoped (see backend minor issues).

rca_of_the_issue: The only failures seen were (a) transient 502s caused by backend hot-reload after writing test files under /app/backend (environment artifact, not an app bug - all tests pass on a settled backend), and (b) two stale Phase 1/2 assertions that still expected the pre-Phase-3 behaviour (503 on /purchase-orders and 401 for rejected-vendor login); both were intentionally changed by the developer, so the test expectations were updated rather than the app.
